summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K notifying shareholders of a Board-approved distribution of R$400 million in Interest on Shareholders' Equity, a Brazilian tax-advantaged dividend equivalent. The per-share gross value is R$0.1674573219, with payment by July 22, 2026, and an ex-rights date of June 22, 2026. A 17.5% withholding tax applies unless exempt. The amount is subject to adjustment for treasury share buyback activity, and if modified, a new notice will be issued. This is a routine capital return, not a tender or special dividend.
